source_state: Existing uncommitted workspace; before and after this Flutter-only review. Not repackaged.
method: Deterministic Widget/Dart fixtures; counts of DTO title reads, backend cancellation calls and rows referenced by disposed page fields. Not wall-clock, heap or process-memory measurement.

measurements.scenario: 2000 actions, open direct shortcut chooser once with empty query
measurements.metric: DTO title reads including filtering and row creation

measurements.scenario: 2000 actions, open context-rule action chooser once with empty query
measurements.metric: DTO title reads including filtering and row creation

measurements.scenario: 50 query edits while the first native cancellation is blocked, then release it
measurements.metric: Total backend cancellation requests before the next edit

measurements.scenario: 4096 application-history rows, dispose while an older read remains blocked
measurements.metric: Result rows still referenced by page.items after disposal

bugs_reproduced_before_fix: Direct action chooser excludes localized titles from matching, so searching its supplied Chinese title returns no row
Application-history page retains its full result list after disposal while a pending Future holds the session
regression_scope: Both shortcut dialogs search translated action titles and lazily create visible rows
Caret and ordinary parent rebuilds reuse matches; catalog replacement uses current action identities
Locale changes update context matching and display labels
Cancellation sharing still waits before a new read; a later read receives a new cancellation
Failed cancellation allows queries to recover
Disposed history cannot publish late rows and drops its earlier result references
baseline_note: The initial combined run had an incorrect search-field finder; the separate corrected Chinese-search run reproduces the direct chooser bug and passes the context-rule control. Performance and cancellation failures in the combined run use the correct fixtures.
limits: Title-read counts depend on the default test viewport; they are not fixed product limits
Nonempty action queries still scan the catalogue; no permanent search-text index is added
Rows referenced by other operations or backends may survive page disposal
No app build/package or running app replacement
No native GUI, physical IME, frame timing, Dart heap/GC or RSS measurement
Impeller and native preview behavior unchanged
code_findings: The direct action chooser uses original titles and default-English context labels regardless of UI locale
